prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Python's default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs by calling cls(*self.args), but MCPError.__init__ expects ErrorData while self.args holds a plain message string, causing TypeError on unpickle for MCPError and its UrlElicitationRequiredError subclass. clusters.pick_reason: PR #2703 is the only self-contained fix: it adds __reduce__ to both MCPError (reconstructing from self.error, preserving the full ErrorData payload) and UrlElicitationRequiredError, closing the hole at every level of the hierarchy.
